purpose: every training-system decision that must be known before the 168-hour Phase 14 run, resolved to exact values. Agent 2 implements this contract without interpretation; nothing here starts Phase 14.

optimizer_state_treatment.decision: fresh AdamW state (zero moments) at Phase 14 start; the KL controller starts at the accepted initial beta 0.005; RNG streams start from the new Phase 14 namespace
optimizer_state_treatment.rationale: Phase 14 is a new run identity (new mixture, new pool, new LR), not a resume of the Phase 9 run; the accepted exact-resume semantics (phase9_checkpoint_v1) are defined within a run. Carrying iteration-41 Adam moments into a changed objective mixture at a different LR would be a reinterpretation of accepted state; a fresh conservative-LR start is the standard continuation posture and the accepted P9-C evidence shows the adaptive KL controller re-damps from beta0=0.005 comfortably (all epoch KLs well under the 0.08 veto at 3e-4; Phase 14 runs at one quarter of that LR).

behavior_policy_kl_regularization.direction: D_KL(pi_b || pi_theta) over every learner-controlled decision of the minibatch
behavior_policy_kl_regularization.adaptive_beta: updated once after each optimizer epoch: mean epoch KL > 0.0300 -> beta *= 2; < 0.0075 -> beta *= 0.5; clamp [1e-4, 0.2]
behavior_policy_kl_regularization.hard_veto: mean epoch/iteration KL > 0.08 or PPO clip fraction > 0.75

advantage_filtering.filter: |A| quantile 0.75 (linear interpolation) with floor 0.01 -> retention 25% of learner decisions for the PPO term only
advantage_filtering.ineligible_handling: ineligible decisions carry the standardized advantage of the eligible subset's moments; the ppo_eligible flag, not the value, excludes them from the PPO loss

ema_behavior.statement: the accepted Phase 9 trainer maintains no EMA of model weights; Phase 14 likewise runs without EMA. The hot-checkpoint 'EMA state' slot records this absence explicitly rather than omitting the field.

batch_update_settings.iteration_structure: accepted bulk-synchronous loop: collect one 2,048-game iteration -> bind targets/advantages/train order -> 2 epochs of minibatch updates -> committed iteration boundary

entropy_schedule.accepted_phase9: linear in the 1-based iteration over the run's own scheduled budget, 0.005 -> 0.001 [entropy_coefficient]
entropy_schedule.phase14_resolution: constant 0.001 (the accepted schedule's terminal value) for the whole run
entropy_schedule.rationale: Phase 14 is wall-clock terminated, so an iteration-indexed schedule has no defined endpoint; the accepted schedule's floor is the accepted late-training entropy level and the conservative continuation choice; re-raising entropy toward 0.005 would be a relearning-style perturbation

trajectory_format.behavior_storage: float32 probabilities in ascending absolute (engine) action order; the sampling walk reads the stored float32 values (accepted Agent 3 decision)

game_rules.source: warmstart_contract.CORPUS_RULES, as consumed by the accepted phase9_collector

values_absent_from_accepted_artifacts: no LR warmup or decay exists (schedule is explicitly 'constant'), so none is invented for Phase 14
no value-loss clipping exists (the value objective is categorical CE; no clipping concept applies)

continuation_learning_rate.derivation: default proposal adopted: 0.25 x LR9 and 0.125 x LR9 exactly; no accepted evidence supports a different pair (the pilot matrix showed 6e-4 unstable at low beta and 1e-4 slower at equal stability; nothing accepted characterizes continuation LRs, so the conservative default stands)
continuation_learning_rate.schedule_within_segment: constant (no warmup, no decay), inherited from the accepted Phase 9 schedule
forbidden: changing LR from live Phase 14 metrics

main_late_schedule.transition_rule: elapsed = current_utc - run_start_utc (ORIGINAL Phase 14 start; downtime counts and never moves the transition). The first collection unit launched with elapsed >= 132h runs under the late segment (late LR 3.75e-5, late opponent mixture); a unit already in flight at the transition finishes under main settings and its optimizer epochs complete under main settings; every unit launched after it uses late settings.
main_late_schedule.transition_utc_derivation: transition_utc = run_start_utc + 475200 seconds, computed once at run start and persisted in every hot checkpoint
main_late_schedule.rationale: the previous 132h/36h split is adopted: 78.57% falls inside the required 75-80% band and no accepted engineering evidence prefers another split

opponent_mixture.derivation: the instruction's preferred 58/30/12 and 40/48/12 mixtures rounded to exact per-iteration counts (games are scheduled counts, never sampled — the accepted Phase 9 idiom); handcrafted 3/3/2/2/2 of 12% realized as 61/61/41/41/41 of 2,048
opponent_mixture.ordinal_layout: contiguous frozen subranges within an iteration, in the order: current, historical, strategic_rule_based, tactical_rule_based, stress_scout_rush, stress_miner_rush, stress_information_miser (the Phase 9 rule_tier_for_ordinal idiom)
opponent_mixture.handcrafted_families: all five exist in the accepted rosters: strategic_rule_based and tactical_rule_based from the frozen rule tiers; stress_scout_rush, stress_miner_rush, stress_information_miser from the frozen Phase 4 stress roster. basic_heuristic and the other three stress policies are not part of the Phase 14 mixture.
opponent_mixture.colour_balance_and_learner_control: unchanged from the accepted Phase 9 collection contract (colour-balance rule and learner-control semantics bound by phase9_contract ad3dba3c...)
opponent_mixture.no_sweep: the mixture percentages are frozen; no opponent-mixture sweep occurs in Phase 14

historical_archive.cadence: one durable snapshot every 2 hours of ORIGINAL Phase 14 elapsed wall-clock (snapshot index j at elapsed >= 2j hours, written at the first committed iteration boundary after crossing the mark)
historical_archive.storage: external training volume, durable; all durable snapshots remain in the archive for the whole run
historical_archive.admission: no tournament; archive admission is automatic on durable write

active_pool_algorithm phase14_active_poo.membership_size: 16 total: 2 permanent anchors + up to 14 Phase 14 snapshots
active_pool_algorithm phase14_active_poo.recompute_event: the pool is a pure function f(k) of the ordered archive [1..k]; it is recomputed immediately after each durable snapshot commit and at every resume

membership_function.k_at_most_14: all k snapshots are active. Age bands by contiguous index ranges: older = indices 1..floor(k/3); middle = floor(k/3)+1..floor(2k/3); recent = floor(2k/3)+1..k (empty bands allowed while k is small).
membership_function.k_greater_than_14: recent = the 6 highest indices {k-5..k}. Let R = [1..k-6] ascending (|R| = k-6 >= 9). older_half = the first ceil(|R|/2) elements of R; middle_half = the rest. older = the 4 quantile picks older_half[floor(i*(len(older_half)-1)/3)] for i in 0..3; middle = the 4 quantile picks middle_half[floor(i*(len(middle_half)-1)/3)] for i in 0..3. (Both halves have length >= 4 whenever k > 14, so the four picks are distinct.)
membership_function.properties: based only on archive ordering/age; no tournament; deterministic when categories are not yet full; no uniform sampling from the accumulated archive

sampling_weights_within_historical_share.within_category: members of a category share its weight equally (anchors: 0.10 P8 + 0.10 P9)
sampling_weights_within_historical_share.empty_category_redistribution: an empty snapshot category's weight is redistributed over the non-empty snapshot categories in proportion to their frozen weights; if all three snapshot categories are empty (k = 0), the entire historical share goes to the anchors, split equally

active_pool_algorithm phase14_active_poo.exact_per_iteration_counts: the historical bucket count H (615 main / 984 late) is partitioned into exact per-member game counts, never sampled: real share = H * w_m; assign floor(share) to every member; assign the remaining games one each by descending fractional part; exact ties broken by canonical member order (P8, P9, older ascending, middle ascending, recent ascending) after rotating the tie-group's order left by (iteration_index mod tie_group_size)
active_pool_algorithm phase14_active_poo.state_and_resume: the exact active-pool membership, category assignment, archive cursor and per-member schedule state are stored in every hot checkpoint; on crash/resume the runner recomputes f(k) from the archived snapshots and REFUSES to continue unless it equals the checkpointed membership exactly

search_prohibition.scope: search may not be used for self-play action selection, training targets, opponent policies, policy improvement, or trajectory generation; Phase 14 trains the direct C1 policy/value system only

hot_resume.cadence: every 15 minutes of wall-clock, written at the first safe optimizer-step boundary at or after each mark
hot_resume.retention: at least the most recent 4 valid hot checkpoints on fast internal storage
required_contents: EMA state (recorded as: absent — no EMA in this system)
storage state required for safe continuation

durable_archive.cadence: every 2 hours of original elapsed wall-clock

final_policy_candidates.definition: a marked subset of the 2-hour archive snapshots, plus the hour-0 starting checkpoint and the hour-168 final state
final_policy_candidates.hour_168_status: a candidate, not automatically the deployed final policy

candidate_evaluation.pack: reports/phase13/phase14_checkpoint_selection_pack_v1.json (pack_content_digest 896a753b3d568902e93e803f1a45de9e8834ff1cdf90bc08cfacf90bcf0c2bde): 128 games per candidate = 32 vs accepted Phase 9 + 32 vs Strategic + 32 vs Tactical + 32 vs Scout-rush; boards, colors, setups, opponent seeds, player seeds, rules and evaluation implementation frozen in the pack document
candidate_evaluation.isolation: evaluations run outside the training loop and may never change ongoing Phase 14 training (no early stop, no LR change, no mixture change, no setup-source change, no pool-logic change, no cadence change, no deadline extension); a failed evaluation preserves the candidate, training continues, the evaluation reruns later on the same frozen pack
candidate_evaluation.no_search: candidates are evaluated as direct policies only; the spent Phase 11 sealed test bank is not touched

wall_clock_contract.run_start_utc: stamped immediately before the Phase 14 training loop begins (not at process start)
wall_clock_contract.persistence: both persisted in every hot checkpoint
wall_clock_contract.restart_semantics: remaining_time = run_deadline_utc - current_time; a restart NEVER creates a fresh 168-hour deadline; downtime counts against the run; the main/late transition uses the original elapsed clock
deadline_behavior: 1. at or after run_deadline_utc, stop launching new collection units
2. finish or safely discard the active bulk unit according to the existing accepted bulk-sync iteration boundary
3. begin no new optimizer step at or after the deadline
5. preserve and mark the hour-168 candidate
6. write final counters and the run manifest
recovery: any recovery attempt starting after the deadline refuses further optimizer steps and finalizes

storage_retention.planning_rate: 3.572 GiB/hour (instruction's soak evidence) -> naive 168h raw archive ~600 GiB
storage_retention.phase9_loop_basis: measured Phase 9 density 27,096.7 B/game at ~1.86 games/s whole-loop -> ~28 GiB/168h; the 600 GiB figure is retained as the conservative ceiling because Phase 14 collection throughput may exceed the Phase 9 serial loop
storage_retention.projection_with_reserve: 600 GiB raw + ~4 GiB archive snapshots (84 x ~45 MB full-state) + ~1 GiB hot/logs/evaluations = ~605 GiB; +20% reserve = ~726 GiB < 994 GiB available
storage_retention.decision: full raw retention FITS and is planned
storage_retention.contingency_rolling_policy: pre-authorized only if free space on the volume falls below 120 GiB during the run: delete already-consumed disposable Phase 14 raw shards oldest-first, retaining all checkpoints, all metrics/summaries, all historical snapshots and a representative 1-in-16 sample of deleted shard ranges; earlier accepted project evidence is never deleted under any condition
storage_retention.hot_checkpoint_storage: fast internal disk (not the external volume)

monitoring_without_tuning.control_interface_rule: no convenient live edit of frozen training values: LR, loss weights, opponent mixture, setup source, historical-pool algorithm, candidate-selection rule and deadline are not writable through the run's control surface; emergency stop remains available
